items.documented_detail: The research provenance describes Raspberry Pi camera-derived jumlahOrang/people_count. The earlier system audit records YOLOv3-tiny and YOLOv8 variants; the CSV does not identify which variant generated the evaluated data.
items.evidence_status: Documented provenance; exact deployed variant unresolved
items.source: docs/data_provenance.md: Hubungan field sumber; docs/repository_audit.md: Sensing and edge acquisition

items.item: Counting mechanism in the inspected variant
items.documented_detail: YOLOv3-tiny person-class detections are filtered by class score > 0.40, minimum box height 100 px and aspect ratio 0.5-4.0, then non-maximum suppression (threshold 0.4) is applied. The count is the number of retained person boxes, not a cumulative entrance/exit counter. If this count is zero, the code uses Haar-cascade face counting; cached face boxes may be retained for up to the configured 0.5 s timeout.
items.evidence_status: Verified in inspected source only; dataset deployment unverified
items.source: people_counter_yolo.py: CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD, NMS_THRESHOLD, MIN_PERSON_HEIGHT, detect_people_yolo, detect_faces, detect_combined

items.documented_detail: The capture loop runs detection for each successfully read frame. TARGET_FPS=60 is a camera setting request, not measured detection throughput. No fixed realized detection interval for the evaluated dataset is documented.
items.evidence_status: Implementation behavior verified; realized dataset cadence unavailable

items.item: Nominal publication cadence in the inspected variant
items.documented_detail: PUBLISH_INTERVAL=5 s; publication is attempted when elapsed time is >5 s inside the capture loop. Processing, scheduling and transmission may delay delivery. This is not a measured camera refresh, gateway-merge or CSV-export interval, and is not verified as the configuration used during data collection.
items.evidence_status: Configured publication rule verified; realized cadence unavailable

items.documented_detail: The research provenance documents a gateway path that merges the latest available sensor state and camera snapshot. The raw export has one combined timestamp and no independent camera-capture timestamp. Exact alignment, occupancy age and camera update cadence cannot be recovered from the CSV.
items.evidence_status: Documented snapshot semantics; timing not independently measurable

items.documented_detail: The supplied research evidence contains no manually annotated ground-truth counts, per-record detector scores or validated counting-error distribution for this observation period. Counting accuracy and uncertainty are therefore not quantified. The detector's class-score threshold is not an occupancy-accuracy percentage or confidence interval.
items.source: Raw export schema; docs/limitations.md; no ground-truth acquisition validation artifact supplied

additional_evidence_needed: Deployment commit, model weights and detector configuration linked to the collection dates and CSV export.
Timestamped camera-update, publication and gateway-merge logs to measure realized cadence and snapshot age.
Time-aligned manually annotated counts covering occupied and unoccupied periods, with a defined counting-error evaluation protocol.
